business_summary: Molitec Steel Co., Ltd. processes and sells colored steel strips, hot rolled steel strips, and steel strips in Japan and internationally. The company trades in steel materials, such as stainless-steel strips and ordinary steel, tempered steel strips; and manufactures and sells processed sheet metal products, including cord reels and springs, as well as processed sheet metal products, including cord reels and springs. The company was formerly known as Mori&Co. and changed its name to Molitec Steel Co., Ltd. in January 1990. Molitec Steel Co., Ltd. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
